text: N'ofe United States, Mexico, na Canada, ama egwuregwu 2026 na-egosi ihe onyinyo nke iwu ama egwuregwu n'ime ọkara narị afọ. Nke kacha ochie, Mexico City's Estadio Banorte, mepere na 1966 ma bụrụ naanị ama egwuregwu nabatara World Cup na 1970, 1986, na 2026. Nke kacha ọhụrụ, Los Angeles's SoFi Stadium, mepere na 2020. N'etiti ha ka Canada's BC Place na BMO Field, nnukwu ụlọ nwere ụlọ elu agbanwere site na gridiron gaa na football, na Mexico's Estadio Akron na Estadio BBVA. Ejiri aka site na Pedro Ramírez Vázquez ruo Populous na HKS, ama ọ bụla bịarutere n'ụdị ọhụrụ maka asọmpi ahụ: ahịhịa eke tọrọ, oche eweghachiri, kọntinent dị njikere ịnabata.
